resolutionNote: Fixed in commit 92194f8: on a comment that already has a PR (actionStatus pr_opened) or is marked done, the edit pencil becomes a Reopen button that queues a follow-up on the existing PR (via the same @jynx-reply mechanism) instead of silently rewriting the text.
